MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 7

2. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

5. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 40.5
   C. 10
   D. 9

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

8. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 2

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

14. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

15. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

16. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

18. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 88
   D. 22

20. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

23. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 41
   C. 3
   D. 40

24. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

25. Solve for x: x + 3 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 13
   D. 12

26. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

27. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

28. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

29. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

30. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
